certifier_removals_reporting_window_chro.name: certifier_removals_reporting_window_chronology
certifier_removals_reporting_window_chro.value: "certifier_removals"."started_on" is null or "certifier_removals"."completed_on" is null or "certifier_removals"."started_on" <= "certifier_removals"."completed_on"

stockpile_events_exception_ref_required.name: stockpile_events_exception_ref_required
stockpile_events_exception_ref_required.value:
"stockpile_events"."ended_at" is null
        or "stockpile_events"."ended_at" <= "stockpile_events"."started_at" + interval '12 months'
        or "stockpile_events"."exception_ref" is not null

credit_batches_isometric_max_one_month.name: credit_batches_isometric_max_one_month
credit_batches_isometric_max_one_month.value:
"credit_batches"."certifier" is distinct from 'isometric'
        or "credit_batches"."end_date" <= ("credit_batches"."start_date" + interval '1 month')::date

credit_batches_ineligible_feedstock_chec.name: credit_batches_ineligible_feedstock_check
credit_batches_ineligible_feedstock_chec.value:
"credit_batches"."ineligible_feedstock_mass_kg" is null
        or "credit_batches"."total_feedstock_mass_kg" is null
        or "credit_batches"."ineligible_feedstock_mass_kg" <= "credit_batches"."total_feedstock_mass_kg"

documents_resolvable.name: documents_resolvable
documents_resolvable.value: "documents"."storage_key" is not null or "documents"."file_url" is not null

documents_storage_fields_cohere.name: documents_storage_fields_cohere
documents_storage_fields_cohere.value: "documents"."storage_key" is null or ("documents"."storage_provider" is not null and "documents"."storage_bucket" is not null)

production_runs_feedstock_dry_lte_wet.name: production_runs_feedstock_dry_lte_wet
production_runs_feedstock_dry_lte_wet.value: "production_runs"."feedstock_wet_mass_kg" is null or "production_runs"."feedstock_mass_dry_kg" is null or "production_runs"."feedstock_mass_dry_kg" <= "production_runs"."feedstock_wet_mass_kg"

production_runs_biochar_dry_lte_wet.name: production_runs_biochar_dry_lte_wet
production_runs_biochar_dry_lte_wet.value: "production_runs"."biochar_output_kg" is null or "production_runs"."biochar_dry_mass_kg" is null or "production_runs"."biochar_dry_mass_kg" <= "production_runs"."biochar_output_kg"

production_processes_method_b_prereqs_ch.name: production_processes_method_b_prereqs_chk
production_processes_method_b_prereqs_ch.value:
"production_processes"."sampling_method" <> 'method_b' OR (
        "production_processes"."method_b_unlocked_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "production_processes"."agreed_baseline_size" IS NOT NULL
        AND "production_processes"."random_sampling_plan_ref" IS NOT NULL
        AND btrim("production_processes"."random_sampling_plan_ref") <> ''
        AND "production_processes"."moisture_pathway" IS NOT NULL
      )

deliveries_mass_dry_lte_wet_mass.name: deliveries_mass_dry_lte_wet_mass
deliveries_mass_dry_lte_wet_mass.value: "deliveries"."mass_dry_kg" is null or "deliveries"."delivered_wet_mass_kg" is null or "deliveries"."mass_dry_kg" <= "deliveries"."delivered_wet_mass_kg"
